summary: The 2013 World Men's Handball Championship was the 23rd edition of the international men's handball tournament, held in Spain from 11 to 27 January 2013. It was the first time Spain hosted the event, making it the twelfth country to do so.
one_line: The 23rd World Men's Handball Championship, held in Spain from 11 to 27 January 2013.
